text:
maya: quick flag 1: after the SDK header normalization rollout, console quota math shows a set of requests as 'unknown route'. looks like route metadata isn't making it through the edge proxy.
aj: which header did the new SDK start emitting? we standardized on `X-Redwood-Route-Meta` casing across languages.
lucas: confirmed locally: normalized header from TS client is `X-Redwood-Route-Meta` and our proxy ACL compares against the exact string `x-redwood-route-meta` lowercased. the ACL code does a strict compare (bug), so mixed-case headers get dropped.
priya: that would blow up quota attribution and route-level dashboards. any affected tenants we should call out?
maya: ACME and two staging tenants saw the spike. sample raw request captured from integration test:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.dev
X-Redwood-Route-Meta: tenant=acme;route=chat;env=prod
Authorization: Bearer xxxx
```

kate: we intentionally had SDKs normalize header casing to keep client behavior consistent. but proxies should be case-insensitive per HTTP specs. the ACL obviously needs to be fixed.
simon: filing infra ticket. immediate patch: change ACL comparison to casefold header names (toLowerCase on both sides) and extend unit tests. low-risk.
lucas: short-term workaround: SDKs can write both variants: keep normalized header but also emit legacy lowercased `x-redwood-route-meta`. small middleware change in both TS and py.
priya: prefer infra fix first, SDK shim second. we shouldn't bake compatibility workarounds forever.
aj: proposed plan: (1) infra: patch ACL and run a canary to edge clusters; (2) devex: ship SDK patch that dual-writes header for immediate compatibility; (3) console: accept both header names for attribution and add telemetry to measure usage; (4) timeline: after metrics show legacy usage <1% we remove shim and flip SDK defaults.
maya: checklist: infra (simon) tests + canary; TS/py hotfixs (maya/lucas); console mapping & metric (kate); release coordination (aj).
kate: console: add metric `route_header_variant` with tags `normalized`, `legacy_lower`, `other`. surface a tenant-level breakdown in the Route Attribution dashboard.
priya: also check quota engine pipeline: we lowercase route names in the bucketing step - ensure dual-write doesn't cause collision or double-normalization.
lucas: sanity check: in my dev run, dual-write restored attribution immediately. TS shim snippet: 
```
// in middleware
const normalized = req.headers['X-Redwood-Route-Meta'] || req.headers['x-redwood-route-meta'];
if (normalized) req.headers['x-redwood-route-meta'] = normalized;
```
py patch mirrors that.
simon: infra PR up: casefold ACL + tests. scheduling canary tonight 22:00 UTC at 10% on edge-a. I'll update when healthy.
maya: for SDK releases let's do a hotfix branch and keep the change opt-in via a flag `preserve_legacy_header=true` default true for one release, then default false once infra stable.
kat e: (typo) kate: console will show a deprecation banner and an advanced toggle in tenant settings to opt into legacy behavior while they migrate.
aj: support request: create alert when a tenant's `route_header_variant` shows >5% legacy after 1 week post-rollout.
priya: add e2e test in proxy integration suite that ensures header matching case-insensitive. also add SDK unit tests for the shim behavior.
lucas: opening PRs now: TS #4581 and py #1012 targeting `hotfix/header-compat`. changelog note: "Dual-write legacy route header to maintain console attribution during infra header normalization rollout."
deploy-bot: [automated] infra/casefold-acl canary started: 22:00 UTC -> edge-a (10%)
simon: canary healthy at 22:13 UTC, no errors. rolling to 25% across edge-a and edge-b at 22:30.
maya: cutting TS v2.4.2-hotfix and py v1.9.3-hotfix in 20m, will include opt-out flag and release notes.
lucas: py wheel uploaded; TS artifact in CI.
kate: console mapping landed in staging. dashboard tile ready, alert RN-855 created for support.
aj: follow-up in two weeks to remove deprecation banner and flip flag defaults once `route_header_variant.legacy_lower` < 1% for active tenants.
priya: also send an email to major customers telling them to upgrade clients or set the advanced toggle if they manage proxies.
maya: thanks team. closing this thread after releases. :rocket:
